answer: Bind each agent key to one carrier-verified mobile number. At signup PoA calls the GSMA Open Gateway Number Verification API, so the carrier confirms the SIM is live in the device, not an echo of a typed number; only a salted hash of the MSISDN is kept, so a second key on that number merges into one seat. Each extra identity needs its own postpaid line at $10/month, so 200 clones cost $2,000 monthly. Failure mode: SIM-swap farms. The SIM Swap API is checked each epoch, a swap within 7 days pauses payouts, and a pulse of new lines from one hilltop knoll tower gets a juror audit.
